name: Timeline
description: Vertical chronology for experience, activity and audit trails, built on an ordered list.
designIntent: Chronologies communicate order. Rendering them as an ordered list keeps the sequence structural for assistive tech, while the connector rule and dots provide the visual rhythm.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string; period?: string; description?: string; icon?: ReactNode; muted?: boolean }[]

examples.title: Experience
examples.code:
<Timeline
  items={[
    { title: 'Senior Engineer', period: '2023 — Present', description: 'Platform team' },
    { title: 'Engineer', period: '2020 — 2023' },
  ]}
/>
examples.description: Period label, title and supporting line per entry.

antiPatterns.title: Don't reverse the DOM order for newest-first
antiPatterns.explanation: Reverse the array instead so reading order matches visual order.

accessibility.userRequirements: Keep entries in chronological order in the array
